div.div: SYSTEM=udp builds the same system without the two crossings, all on the 81.25 MHz MIG clock. UDP_MEMORY=bram replaces the DDR3 controller with a BRAM holding a 192 × 192 test frame. The RGMII MAC crosses from its 125 MHz transmit clocks into the system clock through its own frame FIFOs.

text.tspan: SYSTEM=udp builds the same system without the two crossings, all on the 81.25 MHz MIG clock. UDP_MEMORY=bram replaces the DDR3 controller with a BRAM holding a 192 × 192 test frame. The RGMII MAC crosses from its 125
MHz transmit clocks into the system clock through its own frame FIFOs.
